{{Quote|My father didn't fight in the Clone Wars. He was a navigator on a spice freighter.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''spice freighter''' was any transport used to transport [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] lied to young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], claiming [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had been a spice [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]].<ref name="ANH" /> This did hold a kernel of truth, as Anakin had navigated the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], a spice freighter, a number of times during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> During the Clone Wars, the ''[[Wayfarer (spice transport)|Wayfarer]]'', a vessel operated by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] deserters led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[M'rch]], claimed to be a spice freighter to [[Raid on the Medica|raid]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] ''[[Medica]]''.<ref name="Bacta Raid">{{TCWComicCite|6.35|Bacta Raid}}</ref> Before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Mishowan Shigormallan]] served as a cargo handler aboard a spice freighter.<ref name="SpecForce">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Spice freighters were first mentioned in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" />
